run_create_imagenet_data_files: run the script to extract ImageNet-1K dataset images and labels from a data source directory
run_generate_imagenet_json: run the script with --generate_json flag to produce JSON target files for train and val splits
run_prepare_places205_data: run the script to prepare Places205 dataset data files for both train and val partitions

summarize_get_all_classes: summarize the get_all_classes function that maps directory names to numeric class indices
